summary.name: Magic Hour AI
summary.one_liner: Magic Hour AI is a hosted media tool, available as a ChatGPT app plugin or MCP server, for generating and editing images, videos, and audio.
use_cases: Generate a short video from a text description
Create a square product photo on a studio background
Add lip sync to a video
Call video production APIs from code
summary.what_it_does: The page is the ChatGPT app listing for Magic Hour AI, which lets ChatGPT use Magic Hour's hosted media tools to generate and edit images, videos, and audio. Example prompts on the page include creating a 5-second vertical video, a square studio product photo, and animating an attached photo. The app can follow renders and return results to the chat. Magic Hour also provides an MCP server at mcp.magichour.ai, and the listing names a "create-with-magic-hour" skill. The listing's summary also mentions text-to-video, image-to-video, lip sync, face swap, and production APIs.
notable: Runs inside ChatGPT as an installable plugin/app
Also available as an MCP server (magic-hour) at mcp.magichour.ai
Follows renders and returns results in chat
caveats: Uses ChatGPT app data sharing; chats and memories may be shared with the app, subject to Magic Hour's terms and privacy policy
Pricing is labeled freemium only in the collection listing; the page itself does not list plan details
